name: store-i18n
title: Localized Chrome Web Store screenshot series, all locales
style: v5 — same off-white ground and geometry as store-en@5, rendered from JSON copy instead of static HTML.
sourceOfTruth: assets/promo-copy.json — 54 locales, English is the per-field fallback

captures.note: Resolved per locale at run time, falling back to the English capture when a locale has not been captured. Only the English fallbacks are required up front.

outputs.note: The CWS autofill snippet reads the language from the folder directly containing screenshot-N.png, so <locale>/ must stay the last path segment. Point that snippet at out/store-i18n@5/.
